description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing a buffer queue with BLAST (Buffer Layered Architecture for Surface Tearing) in Android's graphics system. It includes class declarations for BLASTBufferQueue and BLASTBufferItemConsumer, with methods for handling frame transactions, buffer management, and surface control.

classes.name: BLASTBufferItemConsumer
classes.description: A specialized BufferItemConsumer that interacts with BLASTBufferQueue for buffer and frame timestamp management.

classes.name: BLASTBufferQueue
classes.description: Manages a buffer queue with BLAST, handling frame transactions, surface updates, and buffer lifecycle.

methods.name: getIGraphicBufferProducer
methods.description: Returns the IGraphicBufferProducer associated with the buffer queue.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Retrieves the Surface object, optionally including the SurfaceControl handle.

methods.name: isSameSurfaceControl
methods.description: Checks if the provided SurfaceControl is the same as the one associated with this buffer queue.

methods.name: onFrameReplaced
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame is replaced.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new frame is available.

methods.name: onFrameDequeued
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame is dequeued.

methods.name: onFrameCancelled
methods.description: Callback invoked when a frame is cancelled.

methods.name: transactionCommittedCallback
methods.description: Called when a transaction is committed, with timing and stats.

methods.name: transactionCallback
methods.description: Virtual method for transaction callback with timing and stats.

methods.name: releaseBufferCallback
methods.description: Handles buffer release callbacks.

methods.name: releaseBufferCallbackLocked
methods.description: Handles buffer release with lock protection.

methods.name: syncNextTransaction
methods.description: Synchronizes the next transaction, optionally acquiring a single buffer.

methods.name: stopContinuousSyncTransaction
methods.description: Stops ongoing continuous sync transactions.

methods.name: clearSyncTransaction
methods.description: Clears pending sync transactions.

methods.name: mergeWithNextTransaction
methods.description: Merges current buffer transactions with the next transaction.

methods.name: applyPendingTransactions
methods.description: Applies all pending transactions up to a given frame number.

methods.name: gatherPendingTransactions
methods.description: Gathers pending transactions into a single transaction object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates surface parameters such as size and format.

methods.name: setFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the frame rate and related parameters.

methods.name: setFrameTimelineInfo
methods.description: Sets timing information for a specific frame.

methods.name: setSidebandStream
methods.description: Sets a sideband stream for the buffer queue.

methods.name: getLastTransformHint
methods.description: Returns the last transform hint used.

methods.name: getLastAcquiredFrameNum
methods.description: Returns the last acquired frame number.

methods.name: setTransactionHangCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for transaction hang detection.
